A dramatic textbook illustration of an elderly, blind Eli sitting on a stone seat by the city gate. A breathless, distressed messenger with torn clothes and dust on his head is speaking to him. Eli is shown just starting to fall backwards off the seat in shock, dropping his staff. In the background, people are weeping.

King David, looking older and deeply sorrowful, walking barefoot up the Mount of Olives. His head is covered with a mantle, and he is weeping. Around him, loyal servants and soldiers march solemnly. The city of Jerusalem is visible in the background below.

A determined King Asa pointing commandingly as soldiers chop down a wooden idol (an Asherah pole) with axes. In the background, an older woman (Queen Mother Maacah) looks on in shock and anger. The setting is near a rocky stream (the brook Kidron).
